## overlay

- `rain-on-glass` (shader) Raindrops sliding down a window in fits and starts, leaving beaded trails behind them. Overlay. Presets: Storm, Drizzle. Tags: overlay, rain, weather, moody, window, glass.
- `snowfall` (shader) Layers of snowflakes drifting down on the wind, the far ones smaller and softer. Overlay. Presets: Dust motes, Blizzard. Tags: overlay, snow, winter, festive, particles.
- `lens-flare` (shader) An anamorphic lens flare: a long horizontal streak and a chain of ghosts through the centre, following the pointer. Answers press, pointer. Overlay. Presets: Sci-fi blue, Golden hour. Tags: overlay, cinematic, light, interactive, sci-fi.
- `vignette-grain` (shader) Darkened corners and fine animated film grain to lay over any picture. Overlay. Presets: Subtle, Gritty. Tags: overlay, cinematic, film, grain, vintage.
- `scanline-sweep` (shader) A bright scanning line with a glow and fading trail passing across, like a scanner or hologram. Overlay. Presets: Hologram, Barcode scanner. Tags: overlay, scan, hologram, sci-fi, tech.
- `spotlight` (shader) Darkness everywhere but a soft circle of light that follows the pointer or wanders on its own. Answers press, pointer. Overlay. Presets: Stage, Torch. Tags: overlay, interactive, reveal, focus, dramatic.
- `embers` (shader) Glowing sparks rising from below, swaying and flickering out as they cool. Overlay. Presets: Bonfire, Magic sparks. Tags: overlay, fire, sparks, particles, warm.
- `shine-sweep` (shader) A soft diagonal gloss band gliding across now and then, for cards and buttons. Overlay. Presets: Gold foil, Quick glint. Tags: overlay, ui, gloss, premium, button.
- `glare-sweep` (shader) A soft diagonal glare gliding across without a pause, added light to lay over a picture (with plus-lighter blending it adds exactly). Overlay. Presets: Gold, Quick flash. Tags: overlay, glare, light, sweep, gloss, editorial.
- `frost-creep` (shader) Ice crystals creeping in from the edges of the frame and melting back. Overlay. Presets: Hoarfrost, Icy blue. Tags: overlay, ice, winter, frozen, reveal, glass.
- `cobweb-corners` (shader) Dusty, tattered cobwebs strung across the corners of the frame, their threads sagging and gently stirring, with loose strands hanging down: a spooky overlay for a page or picture. Overlay. Presets: Haunted, Fresh, Dark silk. Tags: overlay, web, spider, cobweb, halloween, spooky, haunted, dust.
- `viewfinder` (vector) A camera viewfinder over the picture: corner brackets, a blinking REC light and a running timecode. Takes text. Words go in `label`. Presets: Night vision, Live. Tags: overlay, camera, recording, vlog, frame.

## splatter

- `paint-splatter` (shader) Glossy paint splats landing in layers of a few colours, each a blob with spiky rays, satellite drops and thin flung streaks, slowly fading; clicks throw more. Answers click. Overlay. Presets: Black ink, Neon, Big drops. Tags: splatter, paint, overlay, click, interactive, artistic, playful.
- `ink-splash` (shader) A drop of ink hitting still water and blooming into a swirling cloud of curling tendrils that sinks and clears. Presets: Paper, Crimson, Dark water. Tags: splatter, ink, water, organic, calm, artistic.
- `splash-crown` (shader) A milk-drop coronet: a drop falls, a crown of liquid rises with beads on its points and falls back into rippling rings. Presets: Coffee, Red paint. Tags: splatter, liquid, milk, drop, slow-motion, product.

Video: transition. Presets: Yellow wall, Clean, Drippy. Tags: splatter, paint, transition, image, reveal, slideshow.
